items.title: Richard Wyands interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 7, 2002
items.q: Yeah I worked with Major up there

ctx.x: Rochester and Syracuse you might have been. I think I told you I saw you in Syracuse with Major Holly.
Right. Yeah I worked with Major up there and some other place too right off the Thruway, I forgot the name of it. Rochester, yeah, there used to be a club called Back Stage. Is that true?
I think so and there was the Pythod Room.
